description: Rename a pipeline (new_name) and/or replace its stages with the FULL list in the new order (stages). Stages whose names are still in the list keep their deals. To RENAME a stage without losing its deals write "Old name => New name" in the list. A stage left out is removed and its open deals move to the first stage — tell the person which deals will move before calling. Get the current stages from crm_pipelines first.

stages.description: The complete stage list, first to last. "Old => New" renames.

name: crm_update_pipeline
title: Rename a pipeline or change its stages
